sourceComparison.note: Later test/cleanup fixture changes do not alter these captured production renderers.

captureMethod.popup: Production PopoverController, native status-item anchor and WindowServer own-window capture; production geometry unchanged. Fixed snapshots/history/footer display inputs; no helper operations or hardware mode switches.
captureMethod.settings: Production SettingsWindowController from same combined source, VERSION 4.3.4; in-memory preferences and mock system/helper/update operations; WindowServer own-window capture.
captureMethod.powerData: All readings, time estimates, histories, state/helper/mode inputs are fixed fixtures.

captureCounts.omittedPopup: Separate Standard/Dark charging state capture repeats the charging fixture already included in the Light/Dark matrix; its alternate animation frame is not stored again.

visualInspection.detail: Original PNG pixel size, no image editing or compositing.
visualInspection.findings: Standard Glass native edges have space around rounded corners; Clear retains its window shadow. Time section is below History with separators and right-aligned text, with visible glass footer controls. Six state labels fit. Fresh General Light/Dark display version 4.3.4; smaller Settings typography, monochrome sidebar symbols, Appearance/Support and all five Modules controls remain readable.

cleanup.note: An initial post-run audit detected a late-written empty preference file for one unique VM-only capture domain. Its exact domain was synchronized and removed, the private wrapper cleanup was verified, and the delayed audit found no owned residuals. Initial failure records were retained; no shared daemon, canonical app domain or host installation was changed.

rejectedSetupAttempts.cause: Background runner consumed redirected patch input; corrected by explicit patch -i with before/after harness hash checks.

limitations: Fixed render fixtures do not measure battery-time accuracy or prove real hardware power controls.
VM macOS 26.6.1 does not reproduce the reporter macOS 27.0.1 environment; Cody must confirm Issue #19 before closure.
Static gallery does not itself verify repeated click routing.
